reviews.review: Scrumptious, delightful and amazing game. Tysm China for this game <3

I just bought a PC a couple of days ago, and I had previously owned GR on Xbox.  I knew the game was going to be fun on this system with all the DLC and extras that the devs didn't include for console.  It's really really fun, and I haven't even played in a group yet online.  Solo play is difficult, but entertaining.
The rate at which you spend your "Talent" aka skill points, is decently paced.  Not too fast, but you're also not grinding your life away.  I'd highly recommend this to anyone- each play through is always somewhat different, and always evolving.  I give it a solid 8/10.

Enjoyable gameplay, endless looping.
The only feedback that I could give for improvements is more variety in maps/bosses.

in 2022 there was a 2-week period where my friend's entire life was go to his day shift then come home and play this game with me until we went to sleep. During this time i got carpal tunnel and i continued to play despite that, it's just that good.

servers moves elsewhere and became unreliable, laggy and with frequent failures to connect/synch/join. Games basically unplayable now.


OG review
Great base gunplay, simple-but charming visual style and a good amount of post-launch support. 
even the different characters and eventual "the grind is done, now just spend the special currency to enhance your in-run bonuses" is a nice feeling.

alas the co-op servers have started to throw me into 250+ ping servers 3/4 of the time now which given the "half-second to dash into cover/out-of-the-telegraph-zone or your are dead" reflex-checks tends to put a damper on the fun. 

furthermore the visual VFX-mess now rivals or even surpasses that of gearboxes failed PvP game battleborn
drop/run RNG is high variance
zero forgiveness reflex-checks and enemy moltov-spam make half of most areas a zone of death within seconds of starting a fight
and the super idiotic "if you die in co-op you get no loot, no gold, no upgrades AND can only be revived by someone buying you back alive from a specific peddler" just makes an otherwise great base-experience an exercise in frustration all too often. 

The current season based around RNG-perk enemy pets/summons many of which are the size of chonky enemies and that run around full speed into a group-hug with the tougher foes (blocking bullets and LoS) and vary wildly between "oh it's deleting the entire zone without me doing anything" to "ah, it's blocking my view/aim with it's glowing wire-frame" for the 6th time this room. 

The more that's added to the game the harder it becomes to recommend as visually, wide-area-damage reflex-checks and high RNG variance-wise it simply throws too much crap into the player-view and expects you to keep headshotting using projectile attacks while half your screen is covered in telegraph-attack-warnings and the other half is covered in some form of fire/tornado/bomb effects-spam while enemies slide around like pinballs as they fire flamethrowers, melee seemingly without any need to plant their feet (they just run right through you dealing moderate damage and often applying some form of DoT/knock-effect), lob multi-munition moltovs or simply snipe you from the back of the arena while the chaff takes up your attention.

Barely a recommend at this point as the devs need to seriously tone down the nonsense and get back to point n click player vs room-horde  and less about filling the screen with the maximum amount of fire, bad-stuff and clutter they can jam into each encounter.
